hartwell.subject: A conversation about Hartwell’s next chapter
hartwell.body:
Dear Robert,

I run Summit Aerostructures in Columbus. Your team’s 5-axis work on landing-gear parts has a strong reputation in our industry, and I have a lot of respect for what you have built in Dayton since 1988.

We are looking for a long-term partner in Ohio, and I would value an informal conversation about where you see Hartwell going over the next few years. There is no agenda beyond getting to know each other, and anything we discuss stays between us.

Would you be open to a coffee or a short call in the coming weeks?

Best regards,
Maria Reyes
CEO, Summit Aerostructures

lakeline.subject: An introduction from a fellow Midwest machining company
lakeline.body:
Dear Anna,

I run Summit Aerostructures in Columbus. I have followed Lakeline since your family opened the Grand Rapids plant in 1994, and your precision work for aerospace actuation systems is well regarded among the people we both sell to.

I would value an informal conversation about how you see the next few years for shops like ours. There is no agenda beyond getting to know each other, and anything we discuss stays between us.

Would you be open to a coffee or a short call in the coming weeks?

Best regards,
Maria Reyes
CEO, Summit Aerostructures
